messages.subject: scale_x_date, date_breaks and start date
parts:
Dear all,

consider the following example:


library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
df <- data.frame(date = seq.Date(as.Date('1903-01-01'),
by = 'years', length.out = 100),
y = rnorm(100) )

p <- ggplot(df, aes(date, y)) + geom_line()
print(p)

p + scale_x_date('', breaks = date_breaks("10 years"),
labels = date_format("%Y"))



The first ggplot call produces a nicely scaled x-axis in 20 year steps,
starting with 1900. However, I want 10 year steps, so I tried the
breaks argument. Now the axis starts in 1908 (in general first year in df +
0.5 * date_breaks), which is not what I want.

Is there a way to influence the x-axis start date in combination with
date_breaks?

thanks!

cheers,
stefan

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: scale_x_date, date_breaks and start date
parts:
HI Stefan,

You can use the expand argument for this. After much trial and errror
I find that

labels = date_format("%Y"),
expand=c(.13, 1))

gives the desired result.

Best,
Ista
